1.Nc3 d5 2.f4 d4 3.Ne4 f5 4.Nf2.strategy: Steps back to a safe square from which the knight covers e4, d3 and g4, but it is a passive post and Black has gained space and a tempo. White keeps a sound position and relies on quick development to catch up.

1.Nc3 d5 2.f4 d4 3.Ne4 f5 4.Nf2 Nf6.strategy: Develops and doubles Black's control of e4 and g4, so the retreating knight finds no outpost, and prepares castling. Black keeps its space gains and builds a harmonious set-up around them.
